text:
- The announcement reports the completed outcome of an earlier shareholders’ poll.
- The issuer publishes financial reports through its investor-relations service.
- The payment account and tax reporting arrangements are unaffected.
- Routine settlement enquiries should quote the custody account reference.
- Contact details for administrative enquiries appear in the service directory.
- The intermediary records timestamps when incoming documents are received.
- Copies of the published accounts can be requested from the company secretary.
- Account reconciliations are performed after the close of each business day.
- The custodian maintains an archive of notices for the reporting period.

The current proxy process does not impose a power of attorney.

The custodian maintains an archive of notices for the reporting period.

The issuer publishes financial reports through its investor-relations service.

text:
Holders are invited to approve or reject the merger at a special general meeting.

Retail beneficial owners are excluded from this shareholder poll.

A signed POA is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

Whether voting requires pre-registration for voting remains unresolved pending clarification.

The current proxy process does not impose beneficial-owner disclosure.

We cannot establish from the available terms whether a holdings certificate applies.

No ballot will be rejected because the holder has not arranged the mandatory return of securities on loan.

Lodging a ballot immobilises the voted position until the meeting concludes.

A nominee cannot divide its votes between different choices for the same resolution.

- Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

text:
The proposed transaction is subject to a vote at a special shareholders’ meeting.

Different voting choices cannot be assigned to portions of the same position.

Immobilisation of the voting shares is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

The current proxy process does not impose disclosure of the ultimate investor’s identity.

Beneficial holders with lent shares must arrange their return before voting.

No ballot will be rejected because the holder has not arranged a power of attorney.

The custodian voting deadline was 15 September 2026 at 12:00 UTC.

Only investors satisfying the stated institutional eligibility condition can participate.

The custodian cannot submit the ballot until the required meeting registration is complete.

The holder must provide proof of its securities position for the ballot to be accepted.

Contact details for administrative enquiries appear in the service directory. A beneficial ownership disclosure must accompany the meeting instruction. The registrar confirms that a securities-loan recall is unnecessary for this event. The intermediary records timestamps when incoming documents are received. The issuer publishes financial reports through its investor-relations service. A duly signed power of attorney must accompany the voting direction.

text:
The court-convened meeting will decide the proposed scheme by a shareholder vote.

A holdings certificate must accompany the shareholder voting instruction.

Lodging a ballot immobilises the voted position until the meeting concludes.

The intermediary records timestamps when incoming documents are received.

A prohibition on split voting is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

Beneficial-owner disclosure is an optional service and is not a condition of voting.

The current proxy process does not impose an extra market-specific voting condition.

Holders should keep a copy of any correspondence for their own records.

Current instructions conflict about advance enrolment with the registrar; neither version has priority.

A securities-loan recall is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

The relevant annex is missing, leaving the condition concerning a signed POA uncertain.

The custodian maintains an archive of notices for the reporting period.

Whether voting requires advance enrolment with the registrar remains unresolved pending clarification.

A restriction on dividing the votes is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
Contact details for administrative enquiries appear in the service directory.
Custody fees are reported separately on the periodic account statement.
The register is administered by the issuer’s appointed transfer agent.
The registrar’s postal address is unchanged from the previous circular.

text:
An electronic voting facility is open for this issuer meeting.

The service desk is available during the custodian’s published business hours.

Copies of the published accounts can be requested from the company secretary.

Disclosure of the ultimate investor’s identity is an optional service and is not a condition of voting.

An additional investor-eligibility restriction is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

The beneficial owner has to submit documentary proof of holding for this proxy ballot.

An outstanding securities loan must be terminated and the shares returned for this ballot.

The payment account and tax reporting arrangements are unaffected.

The account currency does not change as a result of this notification.

The issuer publishes financial reports through its investor-relations service.

Holders should keep a copy of any correspondence for their own records.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

Voting representation depends on receipt of the signed power-of-attorney instrument.

Whether voting requires a prohibition on split voting remains unresolved pending clarification.

The register is administered by the issuer’s appointed transfer agent.

Custody fees are reported separately on the periodic account statement.

text:
You can direct the votes attached to the position shown on this meeting notification.

A disposal restriction attaches to each share committed to this ballot.

Current instructions conflict about owner-name reporting; neither version has priority.

The custodian voting deadline was 15 September 2026 at 12:00 UTC.

The intermediary records timestamps when incoming documents are received.

The holder must use a uniform choice for all instructed shares on each motion.

The payment account and tax reporting arrangements are unaffected.

Pre-registration for voting is not required for the current vote.

Custody fees are reported separately on the periodic account statement.

The registrar’s postal address is unchanged from the previous circular.

The service desk is available during the custodian’s published business hours.

A signed POA is an optional service and is not a condition of voting.

The recall of lent stock is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

Copies of the published accounts can be requested from the company secretary.

The account currency does not change as a result of this notification.

Holders should keep a copy of any correspondence for their own records.

The meeting agenda is open for voting by shareholders through the custody chain.
The custodian voting deadline was 15 September 2026 at 12:00 UTC.
Any earlier condition for a uniform-voting condition has been withdrawn and no longer applies.
We cannot establish from the available terms whether the recall of lent stock applies.
Any earlier condition for share blocking has been withdrawn and no longer applies.
The registrar is still investigating the possible requirement for an additional investor-eligibility restriction.
A custodian position confirmation is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
The payment account and tax reporting arrangements are unaffected.
Custody fees are reported separately on the periodic account statement.

text:
Custody operations communication
The proposed transaction is subject to a vote at a special shareholders’ meeting.
Immobilisation of the voting shares is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
Votes can be submitted only by physical attendance, with no remote voting route.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
We cannot establish from the available terms whether documentary proof of ownership applies.
Disclosure of the ultimate investor’s identity is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
A restriction on dividing the votes is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
An attorney mandate for voting is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
Shares on loan must be recalled before the holder can participate in this vote.

The service desk is available during the custodian’s published business hours.

A confirmation of ownership from the custodian is mandatory for this vote.

- Share blocking is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
- The general market guide mentions a power of attorney, but this event is expressly exempt.
- Copies of the published accounts can be requested from the company secretary.
- Contact details for administrative enquiries appear in the service directory.
- The mandatory return of securities on loan is an optional service and is not a condition of voting.
- We cannot establish from the available terms whether a restriction on dividing the votes applies.
- Participation in the vote requires advance enrolment with the registrar.
- Account reconciliations are performed after the close of each business day.
- Custody fees are reported separately on the periodic account statement.
- The account currency does not change as a result of this notification.
- This communication is distributed through the usual securities-services channel.
- The registrar’s postal address is unchanged from the previous circular.
- The custodian maintains an archive of notices for the reporting period.

text:
Custody operations communication
The scheme meeting seeks shareholder approval of the proposed arrangement.
Instructed shares are locked against sale pending completion of the meeting.
An additional investor-eligibility restriction is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
The payment account and tax reporting arrangements are unaffected.
Contact details for administrative enquiries appear in the service directory.
Routine settlement enquiries should quote the custody account reference.
No ballot will be rejected because the holder has not arranged the mandatory return of securities on loan.
Account reconciliations are performed after the close of each business day.
The ultimate beneficial owner’s name and address must be disclosed with each ballot.
The full instructed position must be voted in one direction; split voting is prohibited.
Holders should keep a copy of any correspondence for their own records.
The relevant annex is missing, leaving the condition concerning advance enrolment with the registrar uncertain.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
This communication is distributed through the usual securities-services channel.
Electronic copies of account statements remain available through the portal.
The register is administered by the issuer’s appointed transfer agent.

passage_spans.text: Custody operations communication
The scheme meeting seeks shareholder approval of the proposed arrangement.
Instructed shares are locked against sale pending completion of the meeting.
An additional investor-eligibility restriction is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
The payment account and tax reporting arrangements are unaffected.
Contact details for administrative enquiries appear in the service directory.
Routine settlement enquiries should quote the custody account reference.
No ballot will be rejected because the holder has not arranged the mandatory return of securities on loan.
Account reconciliations are performed after the close of each business day.
The ultimate beneficial owner’s name and address must be disclosed with each ballot.
The full instructed position must be voted in one direction; split voting is prohibited.
Holders should keep a copy of any correspondence for their own records.
The relevant annex is missing, leaving the condition concerning advance enrolment with the registrar uncertain.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
This communication is distributed through the usual securities-services channel.
Electronic copies of account statements remain available through the portal.
The register is administered by the issuer’s appointed transfer agent.

passage_spans.text: Custody operations communication
Beneficiaries may vote remotely on the motions at the class meeting.
A holdings certificate is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
The proxy instruction must carry a wet-ink signature; digital signatures are refused.
Lodging a ballot immobilises the voted position until the meeting concludes.
The relevant annex is missing, leaving the condition concerning an attorney mandate for voting uncertain.
Registration with the meeting agent is compulsory before proxy instructions can be lodged.

text:
- Please indicate how the registered holder should cast your shares at the general meeting.
- Any earlier condition for a custodian position confirmation has been withdrawn and no longer applies.
- The holder must use a uniform choice for all instructed shares on each motion.
- There is no requirement for owner-name reporting in the final terms.
- Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
- No ballot will be rejected because the holder has not arranged a further participation restriction.
- The custodian cannot submit the ballot until the required meeting registration is complete.
- An attorney mandate for voting is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

text:
Beneficiaries may vote remotely on the motions at the class meeting.

Owner-name reporting is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

This communication is distributed through the usual securities-services channel.

A securities-loan recall is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

The intermediary records timestamps when incoming documents are received.

The beneficial owner has to submit documentary proof of holding for this proxy ballot.

A notarised voting power of attorney is compulsory for beneficial owners.

Copies of the published accounts can be requested from the company secretary.

The custodian maintains an archive of notices for the reporting period.

Contact details for administrative enquiries appear in the service directory.

Account reconciliations are performed after the close of each business day.

Holders should keep a copy of any correspondence for their own records.

The custodian voting deadline was 15 September 2026 at 12:00 UTC.

The market accepts only one voting direction for the entire nominee position.

Electronic copies of account statements remain available through the portal.

The ultimate beneficial owner’s name and address must be disclosed with each ballot.
The registrar requires documentary holdings confirmation before accepting proxy directions.
Voting requires the return of securities currently out on loan.

text:
Enclosed is the proxy card for the forthcoming extraordinary shareholder assembly.

The ultimate beneficial owner’s name and address must be disclosed with each ballot.

The definitive instructions remove the preliminary requirement for a restriction on dividing the votes.

An attorney mandate for voting is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

The register is administered by the issuer’s appointed transfer agent.

The registrar’s postal address is unchanged from the previous circular.

A minimum holding of five hundred shares is required to exercise the ballot.

The payment account and tax reporting arrangements are unaffected.

Registration with the meeting agent is compulsory before proxy instructions can be lodged.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

The voting position is frozen from instruction acceptance until the assembly closes.

The mandatory return of securities on loan is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

The account currency does not change as a result of this notification.

The service desk is available during the custodian’s published business hours.

The issuer publishes financial reports through its investor-relations service.

Holders should keep a copy of any correspondence for their own records.

This communication is distributed through the usual securities-services channel.

text:
Custody operations communication
The meeting agenda is open for voting by shareholders through the custody chain.
The custodian maintains an archive of notices for the reporting period.
The account currency does not change as a result of this notification.
The register is administered by the issuer’s appointed transfer agent.
The registrar requires the ultimate owner’s personal details before processing the ballot.
Custody fees are reported separately on the periodic account statement.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
The registrar is still investigating the possible requirement for a custodian position confirmation.
The agent has not confirmed whether a uniform-voting condition is compulsory for this ballot.
The definitive instructions remove the preliminary requirement for an additional investor-eligibility restriction.
The registrar’s postal address is unchanged from the previous circular.
Account reconciliations are performed after the close of each business day.
The registrar is still investigating the possible requirement for pre-registration for voting.
A freeze on instructed securities is an optional service and is not a condition of voting.
Electronic copies of account statements remain available through the portal.
Copies of the published accounts can be requested from the company secretary.

Contact details for administrative enquiries appear in the service directory.
The service desk is available during the custodian’s published business hours.
The custodian maintains an archive of notices for the reporting period.
The account currency does not change as a result of this notification.

- The agent expressly waives the mandatory return of securities on loan for this ballot.
- Advance enrolment with the registrar is not required for the current vote.
- Anonymous proxy directions are rejected; beneficial-owner identification is mandatory.
- Retail beneficial owners are excluded from this shareholder poll.
- Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

Documentary proof of ownership is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

Holders should keep a copy of any correspondence for their own records.

Whether voting requires immobilisation of the voting shares remains unresolved pending clarification.

This communication is distributed through the usual securities-services channel.

Custody fees are reported separately on the periodic account statement.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

The current proxy process does not impose the recall of lent stock.

The account currency does not change as a result of this notification.

The registrar is still investigating the possible requirement for disclosure of the ultimate investor’s identity.

The relevant annex is missing, leaving the condition concerning a holdings certificate uncertain.

An attorney mandate for voting is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

This market requires an original POA to authorise the nominee’s meeting vote.
The instruction is valid only when accompanied by the required position certificate.
The custodian cannot submit the ballot until the required meeting registration is complete.
Only investors satisfying the stated institutional eligibility condition can participate.
The custodian must recall lent stock as a condition of proxy voting.
The agent expressly waives a restriction on dividing the votes for this ballot.

text:
Custody operations communication
Your beneficial holding carries a ballot on the proposed capital reorganisation.
Only investors satisfying the stated institutional eligibility condition can participate.
The issuer publishes financial reports through its investor-relations service.
Copies of the published accounts can be requested from the company secretary.
The register is administered by the issuer’s appointed transfer agent.
Custody fees are reported separately on the periodic account statement.
The beneficial owner must execute the power of attorney before votes can be accepted.
The mandatory return of securities on loan is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
Routine settlement enquiries should quote the custody account reference.
Account reconciliations are performed after the close of each business day.
The account currency does not change as a result of this notification.
Any earlier condition for a freeze on instructed securities has been withdrawn and no longer applies.
The general market guide mentions a holdings certificate, but this event is expressly exempt.
Contact details for administrative enquiries appear in the service directory.
A restriction on dividing the votes is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
The custodian voting deadline was 15 September 2026 at 12:00 UTC.

A restriction on dividing the votes is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

The instruction is valid only when accompanied by the required position certificate.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

Lodging a ballot immobilises the voted position until the meeting concludes.

The registrar confirms that beneficial-owner disclosure is unnecessary for this event.

Voting requires the return of securities currently out on loan.

The agent expressly waives a securities-loan recall for this ballot.

text:
The company has opened its shareholder voting portal for the forthcoming poll.

Any earlier condition for a restriction on dividing the votes has been withdrawn and no longer applies.

The agent expressly waives documentary proof of ownership for this ballot.

Voting requires the custodian to immobilise the securities until adjournment.

Whether voting requires a power of attorney remains unresolved pending clarification.

Loaned shares are eligible only after a mandatory recall has settled.

The registrar requires the ultimate owner’s personal details before processing the ballot.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

Meeting registration is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

text:
Custody operations communication
The election of the supervisory board is subject to the current shareholder ballot.
Custody fees are reported separately on the periodic account statement.
Copies of the published accounts can be requested from the company secretary.
Routine settlement enquiries should quote the custody account reference.
Electronic copies of account statements remain available through the portal.
No ballot will be rejected because the holder has not arranged a signed POA.
The service desk is available during the custodian’s published business hours.
All shares on an instruction must receive an identical voting preference.
Current instructions conflict about a holdings certificate; neither version has priority.
Account reconciliations are performed after the close of each business day.
Shares on loan must be recalled before the holder can participate in this vote.
The registrar is still investigating the possible requirement for meeting registration.
The registrar is still investigating the possible requirement for an extra market-specific voting condition.
There is no requirement for a freeze on instructed securities in the final terms.
The register is administered by the issuer’s appointed transfer agent.
This communication is distributed through the usual securities-services channel.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

- The issuer publishes financial reports through its investor-relations service.
- The current proxy process does not impose an attorney mandate for voting.
- Account reconciliations are performed after the close of each business day.
- The custodian maintains an archive of notices for the reporting period.
- Holders may vote without share blocking.

text:
- Shareholder approval is being sought by written resolution; voting directions are accepted.
- The registrar is still investigating the possible requirement for immobilisation of the voting shares.
- Copies of the published accounts can be requested from the company secretary.
- Contact details for administrative enquiries appear in the service directory.
- The holder is free to vote without arranging a holdings certificate.
- Holders may vote without the recall of lent stock.
- A prohibition on split voting is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
- Disclosure of the underlying investor’s identity is required for acceptance of votes.
- The current proxy process does not impose a power of attorney.
- The custodian cannot submit the ballot until the required meeting registration is complete.
- Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
- The general market guide mentions a further participation restriction, but this event is expressly exempt.

text:
Shareholder approval is being sought by written resolution; voting directions are accepted.

The registrar’s postal address is unchanged from the previous circular.

The issuer publishes financial reports through its investor-relations service.

The account currency does not change as a result of this notification.

The service desk is available during the custodian’s published business hours.

The intermediary records timestamps when incoming documents are received.

Account reconciliations are performed after the close of each business day.

Only investors satisfying the stated institutional eligibility condition can participate.

The ballot is subject to a prohibition on split votes.

Contact details for administrative enquiries appear in the service directory.

Holders should keep a copy of any correspondence for their own records.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

The holder is free to vote without arranging the mandatory return of securities on loan.

No ballot will be rejected because the holder has not arranged beneficial-owner disclosure.

This market requires an original POA to authorise the nominee’s meeting vote.

text:
The shareholders’ assembly will vote on the remuneration report and election of directors.

Disclosure of the ultimate investor’s identity is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

Different voting choices cannot be assigned to portions of the same position.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.

Beneficial holders with lent shares must arrange their return before voting.

Meeting registration is an optional service and is not a condition of voting.

A duly signed power of attorney must accompany the voting direction.

A further participation restriction is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

A disposal restriction attaches to each share committed to this ballot.

Shareholder approval is being sought by written resolution; voting directions are accepted.
The account currency does not change as a result of this notification.
Registration is mandatory even for holders voting electronically through the nominee.
The agent expressly waives a uniform-voting condition for this ballot.
The registrar’s postal address is unchanged from the previous circular.
Routine settlement enquiries should quote the custody account reference.
The voting service requires a recall of the relevant securities-lending positions.
Electronic copies of account statements remain available through the portal.
The custodian maintains an archive of notices for the reporting period.
Copies of the published accounts can be requested from the company secretary.
Account reconciliations are performed after the close of each business day.
Disclosure of the ultimate investor’s identity is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
Voting eligibility must be supported by a current ownership certificate.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Holders should keep a copy of any correspondence for their own records.
This market requires an original POA to authorise the nominee’s meeting vote.

text:
- The nominee is accepting ballots on the resolutions at the upcoming annual assembly.
- The holder is free to vote without arranging disclosure of the ultimate investor’s identity.
- Pre-registration for voting is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
- This market requires an original POA to authorise the nominee’s meeting vote.
- The general market guide mentions a uniform-voting condition, but this event is expressly exempt.
- The custodian must block the instructed shares for the duration of the voting process.
- Account reconciliations are performed after the close of each business day.
- The mandatory return of securities on loan is not required for the current vote.
- The service desk is available during the custodian’s published business hours.
- An additional investor-eligibility restriction is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.

text:
Custody operations communication
This operational notice invites proxy votes on current shareholder resolutions.
The voting form must identify the beneficial owner behind the custody account.
The registrar confirms that a custodian position confirmation is unnecessary for this event.
Meeting registration is optional and is not a prerequisite for voting.
The custodian must recall lent stock as a condition of proxy voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
There is no requirement for a power of attorney in the final terms.
The agent has not confirmed whether an extra market-specific voting condition is compulsory for this ballot.
